construction: Owner clarified that the Filled box must keep 2px outside clearance and Outline is exactly the X inside that Filled box, following Plus. Its negative-space X and the standalone Outline share diagonal centerline endpoints 4.85..19.15 on each axis, giving visible glyph bounds 4..20. The shared glyph retains Regular-equivalent width 1.70 and .85 round caps. This leaves exactly 2 units between the glyph and each box side, plus 2 units between the box and each artboard side. The cutout is the exact analytical union of the Outline stroke exterior. Both glyphs are centered at 12,12 with identical position, size and contours; no style-specific scaling or translation. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Owner-approved source. The owner subsequently requested rounder Filled box corners: radius is 4, with box bounds, glyph contour, stroke weight and the measured 2-unit side clearances retained. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Centerlines uniformly refitted about12,12 by 0.9965034965 to retain the existing2px primary margins and shared boxed glyph clearance. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.
